ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a blue-filled rectangle, with the bottom side labeled 54 and the left height labeled 62. The right side of the rectangle is connected to a triangle, and the triangle and rectangle share a vertical dashed side; this dashed side is the same as the rectangle's height, 62. Inside the triangle there is a horizontal dashed line labeled 27, indicating the perpendicular distance from the vertical dashed side to the right-side vertex. Reasoning: Divide the entire figure into the rectangle on the left and the triangle on the right. The area of the rectangle is 54 × 62 = 3348. The base of the triangle is 62 and the height is 27, so the area of the triangle is (1/2) × 62 × 27 = 837. The total area is 3348 + 837 = 4185.

method.method_draft: Read the figure as a 54 by 62 rectangle with a triangular part attached on the right.
